{{Quote|If I know Teff'ith, she'll be hanging around the dirtiest, nastiest, most dangerous spot to get a drink in this place.''"<br />"''That'd be the Crooked Finger.|[[Theron Shan]] and a [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]] customs agent|<ref name="TOR Annihilation" />}}
The '''Crooked Finger''' was a bar in [[Jigani Port]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]]. When the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|spy]] [[Theron Shan]] were looking for a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] named [[Teff'ith]], they were directed to the Crooked Finger. Upon their arrival, it was populated by criminals and armed thugs. Two large [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] were standing by the door and tried to extort the pair for a fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] cover fee, but Master Dural convinced the Nikto, using a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]], that he and Shan were friends of the bar's owner.<ref name="TOR Annihilation" />
